description:
Haus of Tiles, LLC · Remote · Written support only.

About Haus of Tiles

Haus of Tiles is a design-first mahjong lifestyle brand based in Dripping Springs, Texas. We make tile sets, mats, racks and accessories that are meant to be mixed, matched and left out on display. Our tiles are deeply engraved and then painted by machine, by hand or both, and every collection is designed by our co-founder Jenna, who is an interior designer.

We launched in April 2026, and the response has been bigger and faster than we planned for. We are a small team run by two co-founders, working with manufacturing partners overseas and a fulfillment partner in Austin.

Our customers care a lot about what they buy. Many of them are planning game nights, buying gifts, or waiting on a pre-order for a set they have been watching for months. They deserve someone on the other end who knows the product and actually follows through.

About the role

Right now, one of our co-founders answers nearly every customer message himself. We are looking for the first person to own customer support with us and to help shape how it works as we grow.

Most of your day will be written conversations with customers by email, through our help desk, and in Instagram and Facebook messages, with other channels likely to be added over time. There is no phone support.

This is not a script-reading job. Plenty of what comes in is routine: order status, shipping rates, product sizes, restock timing. The part we really need help with is everything else. A tracking number that hasn't moved in a week. A rack that arrived cracked and photos that won't upload. An address that looks like a mix-up. A customer who has been waiting on a delayed pre-order and is running out of patience. Those take judgment, some digging across Shopify, our help desk and our fulfillment partner, and a reply that sounds like a real person who cares how it turns out.

You will also be the person who sees patterns first. If the same question keeps coming in, we want you to tell us why and help fix it at the source, whether that means rewriting an FAQ, updating a saved reply, flagging a product page that is confusing people, or suggesting a better process with our warehouse.

What you'll do

Answer customer emails, help desk tickets and social media messages promptly, in a warm, clear voice that fits our brand
Handle order questions, including status, tracking, address changes, cancellations and returns, following our policies and knowing when a decision should come to us
Look into shipping problems such as stalled tracking, lost packages and international duties, and stay with them alongside our fulfillment partner and the carriers until there is an answer
Review damage and defect claims, ask the right follow-up questions, and gather what we need to make a decision
Keep pre-order and restock customers informed honestly, including when timing moves
Keep the help desk organized, with good tags, useful saved replies and a clean queue
Track recurring issues and bring us clear, practical ideas for fixing them
Help build and maintain our support playbook as policies change
Use AI drafting tools where they help, and catch it when a draft gets the facts or the tone wrong

What we're looking for

Fluent written English. You will be writing to customers all day and working closely with us in English, so this is essential.
At least two years in customer support or customer success, ideally with an ecommerce or direct-to-consumer brand
Hands-on experience with a ticketing or help desk system and a solid understanding of how a support process should run
Good judgment. You can tell a question that needs a quick answer from a problem that needs real investigation, and you know when to ask before acting.
A problem solver's instinct. You follow things through to the end instead of passing them along.
Organized and dependable when working on your own
Comfortable at a small, fast-moving company where things change and not everything is written down yet

Nice to have

Experience with Shopify, especially orders, refunds and customer accounts
Experience with Gorgias, or with similar tools like Zendesk, Gladly or Freshdesk
Familiarity with third-party fulfillment, carriers and shipping
Experience helping a small company set up or improve its support process
An eye for design and well-made products
You don't need to play mahjong. We will teach you the products.

The details

Fully remote, and we are open to candidates outside the United States
Written support only, no phone calls
Working hours that overlap meaningfully with US Central Time
Schedule: full-time
Pay: roughly $1,500 to $2,200 USD per month, based on experience
Product launches and the holidays are our busiest stretches, so some flexibility during those periods helps.

title: Client Support Analyst
skills: Work within the Q4 Studio Content Management System to assist publicly traded clients in maintaining up-to-date websites compliant with regulatory standards.
Manage ad hoc support requests, which involve updating website layouts, documents, and board of directors pages.
Facilitate high-impact content updates, including the addition or replacement of webcasting information, presentations, disclosure documents (press releases and financial reports), and ESG materials.
Communicate with clients frequently and professionally,, primarily via email and phone to keep them informed on the status of their requests.
Ensure timely delivery of client updates.
Adhere to strict Service Level Agreements (SLAs), specifically addressing new cases within 60 minutes and reopened cases within 30 minutes.
Conduct frequent quality review checks when performing site updates to ensure accuracy and quality of work.
Customer Service Excellence: 1-2 years of customer service experience. Professional customer support experience is prioritized over real-world technical application.

Technical Knowledge: Demonstrated knowledge of HTML and CSS. Basic knowledge of JavaScript and jQuery is required. Candidates who have acquired these technical skills through courses or training, but lack real-world application, are highly encouraged to apply if they possess strong customer support experience.
Systems Experience: Experience working in content management systems. Experience with ticketing systems is required, with specific preference for Salesforce.
Core Attributes: Excellent communication skills, both written and verbal, in English. Strong organizational and detail-oriented approach. Independent troubleshooting capabilities.
Environment: Working knowledge of PC and Mac-based environments. Financial experience is considered a bonus.

Metrics: Employee performance is tracked through availability, Case Time Entry (CTE), customer satisfaction (CSAT) scores, First Contact Resolution (FCR) metrics for phones, and issue logs related to escalations.
Growth Opportunities: Analysts begin managing ad hoc requests, and after six months to one year, may transition to working on quarterly earnings updates and product-related testing.
Advancement: After one to two years, staff members are eligible to pursue internal opportunities within the activations, technical product support, QA engineering, or earnings teams.
Peak Periods: The team's biggest operational challenge is managing high, urgent volumes during the quarterly earnings peak, which spans four to five weeks.
Blackout Windows: The quarterly earnings peak is a strict blackout window for time off and vacations to ensure SLAs are met.

Availability: This position may require non-business hours activities such as critical client events, escalations, and holiday coverage, including after-hours, weekend, and holiday support as needed for earnings and/or emergencies.

Come grow with us!

Working Conditions

Availability: This position may require non-business hours activities such as critical client events, escalations, and holiday coverage, including after-hours, weekend, and holiday support as needed for earnings and/or emergencies.


Selection Process

Stage 3: Leadership Interview: An interview with the department leader.

description:
Who we are

About Stripe

Stripe is a financial infrastructure platform for businesses. Millions of companies—from the world’s largest enterprises to the most ambitious startups—use Stripe to accept payments, grow their revenue, and accelerate new business opportunities. Our mission is to increase the GDP of the internet, and we have a staggering amount of work ahead. That means you have an unprecedented opportunity to put the global economy within everyone’s reach while doing the most important work of your career.

About The Team

At Stripe, our Mexico City office is a vibrant hub at the forefront of our mission to reshape the financial landscape for businesses worldwide. Our team prioritizes collaboration, innovation, and excellence. As a member of the Mexico City team, you'll be part of a mission-driven community dedicated to enhancing the global economy and increasing the GDP of the internet. We strive for excellence by creating with craft and beauty, while having fun and celebrating our successes together.

We cultivate a culture of collaboration, inclusivity and support where every team member’s voice matters. Our commitment shines through as we handle over a million support cases each year, empowering our users not just to solve problems but to achieve their goals.

What you’ll do

Responsibilities


Troubleshoot and solve external user issues
Communicate resolutions to end users in English
Analyze our processes and instigate changes to help scale our operations and improve user experience
Work closely with other Stripe teams to improve our product offerings and messaging around new products and features
Gain unique insights into how thousands of businesses on Stripe scale and operate
Have an opportunity to learn how Stripe operates from ground up and make a real impact on the future organization
Be a part of building a brand new team and operational culture for Stripe
Partner with global operations specialists or business process owners to run a critical workflow



Who you are

We’re looking for someone who meets the minimum requirements to be considered for the role. If you meet these requirements, you are encouraged to apply. The preferred qualifications are a bonus, not a requirement.

Minimum Requirements


You have a user first mindset and are energized by the challenge of solving difficult problems
You have excellent communication skills, both written and verbal
You have business proficiency in written and spoken English
You excel in analytical thinking and problem solving
You might have prior experience in customer service or internal/external user facing operations
You enjoy learning about technical products and processes, you are an organized, self-starter with passion for finding solutions to user’s challenges
You have a process-oriented mindset and ability to get things done
You enjoy working in an in-office environment with strong cross team collaboration and support
You are able to prioritize and enjoy working in a quick-moving environment
You are humble and have a proven track record for working well across teams and with external partners
You're willing to periodically work a weekend day for which you will receive a weekday off; the SDC operates during daytime hours with shifts from the morning through early evening



Preferred Qualifications


Prior experience or knowledge in user support
Prior experience working on projects or process improvement initiatives
Familiarity with SQL and ability to use template or premade SQL queries as part of investigations



Applicants are personally responsible for obtaining and maintaining the right to work in Mexico.

In-office expectations

Office-assigned Stripes in most of our locations are currently expected to spend at least 50% of the time in a given month in their local office or with users. This expectation may vary depending on role, team and location. For example, Stripes in Stripe Delivery Center roles in Mexico City, Mexico, Bengaluru, India, and Dublin, Ireland work 100% from the office. Stripes on the Works in Progress team based in the London, UK office also work 100% from the office. Also, some teams have greater in-office attendance requirements, to appropriately support our users and workflows, which the hiring manager will discuss. This approach helps strike a balance between bringing people together for in-person collaboration and learning from each other, while supporting flexibility when possible.

Pay and benefits

Stripe does not yet include pay ranges in job postings in every country. Stripe strongly values pay transparency and is working toward pay transparency globally.

We look forward to hearing from you.

At Stripe, we're looking for people with passion, grit, and integrity. You're encouraged to apply even if your experience doesn't precisely match the job description. Your skills and passion will stand out—and set you apart—especially if your career has taken some extraordinary twists and turns. At Stripe, we welcome diverse perspectives and people who think rigorously and aren't afraid to challenge assumptions. Join us.

description:
At Qualtrics, we create software the world’s best brands use to deliver exceptional frontline experiences, build high-performing teams, and design products people love. But we are more than a platform—we are the creators and stewards of the Experience Management category serving over 18K clients globally. Building a category takes grit, determination, and a disdain for convention—but most of all it requires close-knit, high-functioning teams with an unwavering dedication to serving our customers.

When you join one of our teams, you’ll be part of a nimble group that’s empowered to set aggressive goals and move fast to achieve them. Strategic risks are encouraged and complex problems are solved together, by passing the microphone and iterating until the best solution comes to light. You won’t have to look to find growth opportunities—ready or not, they’ll find you. From retail to government to healthcare, we’re on a mission to bring humanity, connection, and empathy back to business. Join over 5,000 people across the globe who think that’s work worth doing.

Technical Customer Manager - Portuguese Speaking

Why We Have This Role

The Technical Customer Manager plays a pivotal part in Qualtrics' success by leading the design, delivery and ongoing success of customers’ experience programs, focused on driving measurable business impact. In this role, you will partner with customers throughout their lifecycle - from program delivery and onboarding to ongoing optimization, adoption and value realization. You will act as the primary technology trusted advisor for your portfolio, leading medium and large-scale software implementations and optimizing our technology to address individual challenges, ultimately building our customers into lifelong Qualtrics champions.

How You’ll Find Success


You will find success by blending exceptional customer and project management skills with a focus on technical platform adoption, renewals, and expansion. 
You will lead project teams to deliver complex programs within our specific Industry Verticals and Region, ensuring your customers deepen and broaden their usage of the platform. 
By influencing customers to shape their feedback programs and being resourceful when facing challenges, you will drive leading indicators of success, value realization, and Net ARR growth.

Expand your cross-functional and industry footprint: You will act as the critical bridge collaborating internally with project managers, engineering, account executive and product teams, while deepening your specialized knowledge of significant industry shifts taking place in experience management.

GTM Manager at BairesDev




In this role, you'll be the closest partner our commercial teams have inside Growth Marketing, working daily with US-based sales and account leaders. This is a hands-on individual contributor position that blends account-based campaign execution with building the AI-powered automations that tell sellers exactly when to act. This is your opportunity to shape how data and AI directly drive new deals and account expansion, using tools like Claude as part of your daily workflow.




What You'll Do:




- Plan and run account-based campaigns for target and existing accounts across email, LinkedIn messaging, LinkedIn Ads, and direct mail, coordinated with each account's sales owner.

- Map commercial processes with sales and account teams and build automations (CRM, Clay, n8n/Make/Zapier, LLM steps) that detect account signals and alert sellers when to take action.

- Build and maintain the data behind these programs, including target-account lists, buying committees, and enriched account and contact records in CRM portals.

- Report weekly to commercial leaders on outcomes, including meetings booked, opportunities created, deals accelerated, accounts expanded, and revenue influenced.

- Test new channels and plays beyond the core four, such as event follow-up, video, or retargeting, and scale the ones that move pipeline.




What we are looking for:




- 2+ years running account-based marketing (ABM) programs in direct partnership with sales or account management teams, including co-selecting target accounts, building joint account plans, and reporting account-level pipeline or expansion to sales leaders.

- 2+ years building automations used by sellers, such as signal/trigger-based workflows, data enrichment, and lead/account routing with tools like Clay, n8n, Make, Zapier, HubSpot, or Salesforce workflows.

- 2+ years working with US-based commercial teams or marketing to US B2B buyers.

- Hands-on experience executing multi-channel campaigns across at least three of: email sequences, LinkedIn messaging, LinkedIn Ads, and direct mail/gifting, with email sequences and LinkedIn required.

- Daily, hands-on use of generative AI or LLM tools (Claude preferred; ChatGPT or Gemini accepted) inside automations, not only for writing copy.

- Native or bilingual proficiency in English.




Nice to have:




- Industrial or process engineering background, or documented process-mapping work (BPMN, swimlanes in Lucidchart/Miro) used to design sales or marketing workflows.

- Experience in B2B tech services, IT staffing, or nearshore/outsourcing companies.

- Background running campaigns aimed at existing accounts, such as expansion, cross-sell, or renewal plays with account managers.

- Familiarity with intent data or ABM platforms (6sense, Demandbase, ZoomInfo, Bombora, Common Room).

- Scripting experience for automations (Python, JavaScript, or SQL; APIs and webhooks).




How we do make your work (and your life) easier:




- 100% remote work (from anywhere).

- Excellent compensation in USD or your local currency if preferred

- Hardware and software setup for you to work from home.

- Flexible hours: create your own schedule.

Investigación de temporalidades y oportunidades comerciales: Identificar y analizar fechas relevantes para México, Colombia y Brasil, incluyendo eventos comerciales (Hot Sale, Buen Fin, Black Friday, Cyber Monday, Navidad, Día de las Madres, Día sin IVA en Colombia, entre otros), temporadas de alta demanda logística y momentos clave para emprendedores y negocios de e-commerce.

Planeación de campañas estacionales: Construir y mantener un calendario anual de temporalidades y oportunidades comerciales. Colaborar en la definición de campañas por mercado, objetivos, prioridades y tiempos de ejecución.
Estrategia y posicionamiento de marca: Apoyar al Brand Manager en el desarrollo y evolución de la estrategia de marca, contribuyendo a consolidar a Skydropx como referente en soluciones logísticas.

Identidad y lineamientos de comunicación: Trabajar en conjunto con la Líder de Diseño para mantener actualizados el brand book, la guía de tono de voz y el framework de mensajes clave por audiencia y mercado.
Análisis de mercado y competencia: Monitorear a competidores, tendencias de las industrias logística y de e-commerce, así como la percepción y posicionamiento de la marca.
Oportunidades de diferenciación: Identificar y proponer territorios de comunicación, mensajes y estrategias creativas que fortalezcan la diferenciación de Skydropx en el mercado.

Indicadores de marca: Dar seguimiento a métricas de salud de marca, como awareness, consistencia, sentimiento y share of voice, para identificar oportunidades de mejora y evaluar el impacto de las iniciativas.
Formación académica: Licenciatura en Mercadotecnia, Ciencias de la Comunicación, Publicidad, Diseño Gráfico, Diseño de la Comunicación Visual o carreras afines.
Experiencia en análisis e interpretación de métricas y KPIs de marca, como alcance, engagement, share of voice, sentimiento y NPS.
Manejo de herramientas de analítica y monitoreo, como Google Analytics, Meta Business Suite y plataformas de social listening (Brandwatch, Sprout Social, Hootsuite).
Manejo de Excel o Google Sheets a nivel intermedio para la elaboración de reportes y análisis de información.
Experiencia en la construcción e implementación de lineamientos de marca (brand guidelines / brand book), incluyendo identidad visual, tono de voz, mensajes clave y arquitectura de marca.
Conocimiento de fundamentos de posicionamiento, propuesta de valor y diferenciación frente a la competencia.
Conocimientos en investigación de mercado y análisis de audiencias: buyer personas, encuestas, focus groups y estudios de percepción de marca (brand awareness y brand health).
Habilidades y competencias
Comunicación efectiva: Capacidad para comunicar ideas de manera clara y persuasiva, tanto oralmente como por escrito, presentar propuestas y argumentar decisiones de marca ante diferentes áreas.
Storytelling: Habilidad para transformar atributos y valores de marca en historias y mensajes relevantes que conecten con las audiencias.
Redacción y ortografía: Excelente dominio de la escritura, con atención a la claridad, coherencia y correcta aplicación del lenguaje.
Pensamiento estratégico: Capacidad para comprender el impacto de cada iniciativa en el posicionamiento y construcción de marca a largo plazo.
Visión de negocio: Habilidad para alinear las estrategias y decisiones de marca con los objetivos comerciales de la organización.
Pensamiento analítico: Capacidad para interpretar datos, identificar tendencias y tomar decisiones fundamentadas en información y evidencia.
Criterio estético y atención al detalle: Sensibilidad visual para identificar inconsistencias y asegurar la coherencia de los elementos gráficos y mensajes de marca.
Organización y gestión de prioridades: Capacidad para administrar varios proyectos simultáneamente, cumplir tiempos de entrega y mantener la calidad de los resultados.

Salario: Competitivo y negociable según experiencia, habilidades y resultados del proceso de contratación.

description:
**Acerca del empleo** 




En Prominox somos una empresa 100 % mexicana con más de 35 años de experiencia, líder a nivel nacional en la comercialización y transformación de acero inoxidable, aluminio y tubería conduit. Contamos con 19 sucursales, un Centro de Servicio y un CEDIS en el país, atendiendo a sectores clave como el automotriz, minero, de manufactura, transporte y electrodomésticos. 




**Objetivo del puesto:** 




Liderar la estrategia de posicionamiento de marca y generación de demanda B2B para México y EU, integrando canales digitales, inteligencia comercial, activaciones industriales y herramientas de apoyo para acelerar el ciclo de ventas en nuestras 19 sucursales. 




**Responsabilidades principales:** 




* Diseñar y ejecutar estrategias de generación de demanda y captación de *leads* calificados (MQLs) para el sector industrial.

* Implementar campañas de Account-Based Marketing (ABM) dirigidas a cuentas clave en las industrias automotriz, minera y de manufactura.

* Desarrollar materiales de *Sales Enablement* (catálogos técnicos, fichas de producto, casos de éxito y presentaciones comerciales) para la fuerza de ventas.

* Gestionar pauta digital B2B (LinkedIn Ads, Google Ads) y estrategias de posicionamiento orgánico (SEO) enfocadas en compradores industriales e ingenieros de proyectos.

* Medir y optimizar el retorno de inversión (ROI), el costo por adquisición (CAC) y la conversión del embudo comercial mediante el uso de CRM y analítica web.

* Coordinar la presencia de marca en exposiciones industriales, eventos B2B, campañas *outdoor* y comunicación interna para más de 500 colaboradores.




**Requisitos y habilidades avanzadas:** 




* **Escolaridad:** Licenciatura concluida en Mercadotecnia, Comunicación, Negocios Internacionales o carrera afín.

* **Experiencia:** Mínimo 2 a 3 años en roles de Marketing B2B, preferentemente en el sector industrial, metalmecánico, manufacturero o de construcción.

* **Generación de demanda y pauta:** Dominio comprobable de LinkedIn Campaign Manager, Google Ads (búsqueda y display) y estrategias de *Inbound Marketing*.

* **CRM y automatización:** Manejo avanzado de plataformas CRM (como HubSpot, Salesforce o Zoho) para dar seguimiento al *pipeline* comercial y nutrir prospectos.

* **Analítica y métricas:** Capacidad para interpretar datos en Google Analytics 4 (GA4), construir tableros de KPIs y optimizar tasas de conversión.

* **Marketing técnico y de contenidos:** Habilidad para traducir especificaciones técnicas de materiales (aceros, aleaciones, normativas) en propuestas de valor claras para gerentes de compras e ingenieros.

* **Indispensable:** Licencia de conducir vigente y dominio de vehículo estándar para logística en campo y visitas a sucursales.




**Ofrecemos:** 




* Sueldo base competitivo

* Prestaciones de ley y superiores.

* Fondo de ahorro y vales de despensa.

* Seguro de vida.

skills: Design, implement, and continuously refine marketing attribution models across all channels, ensuring they reflect the true complexity of the customer journey.

Define incrementality measurement approaches (geo holdouts, intent-to-treat analyses, synthetic controls) to evaluate the true causal impact of marketing investments beyond last-touch or even multi-touch models.
Own attribution methodology decisions and communicate trade-offs clearly to stakeholders and leadership.
Lead the implementation and maintenance of tracking infrastructure: pixel setup, tag management (Google Tag Manager or equivalent), and event tracking across web and app.
Design and implement server-to-server (S2S) integrations to improve signal quality, reduce data loss from browser restrictions, and enhance campaign optimization inputs for paid media platforms.
Audit and troubleshoot data discrepancies across tracking systems, ensuring data accuracy and integrity end-to-end.
Manage and evolve the marketing analytics stack (GA4, Amplitude, third-party attribution tools, Databricks) and stay current on emerging measurement technologies and privacy-driven changes.
Partner with Data Engineering and Product to improve event schemas, tracking coverage, and data pipeline reliability.
Pull, structure, and analyze your own data independently building the analyses needed to reach conclusions and push initiatives forward, without relying on others to surface information.
Develop and maintain dashboards and reports that give clear, actionable visibility into campaign performance, channel ROI, and attribution trends.
Identify patterns and anomalies proactively; bring forward recommendations with a clear point of view, not just observations.
Use advanced analytics to correlate marketing activities with business outcomes, providing the strategic inputs needed for budget allocation and channel mix decisions.
Collaborate with Performance and Lifecycle marketing teams to translate attribution insights into concrete campaign optimizations.
Conduct A/B and multivariate experiments to validate attribution assumptions and improve measurement accuracy over time.
Help forecast marketing budgets based on attribution data and provide a clear framework for where to allocate spend for maximum ROI.
Act as the internal expert on attribution and measurement educating teams on best practices and building shared understanding across marketing, data, and finance.
5+ years of experience in marketing analytics, growth analytics, or a closely related field, with a strong track record of operating autonomously on complex, end-to-end projects.

Deep technical expertise in tracking implementation: tag management (GTM or equivalent), pixel setup, event tracking across web and mobile, and server-to-server integrations for campaign signal optimization.
Strong command of attribution modeling: multi-touch, data-driven, and incrementality-based approaches with the ability to articulate the limitations of each and when to apply them.

Developed analytical sensibility for second-order effects: able to reason about indirect, non-attributable contributions of marketing initiatives and incorporate that thinking into budget and strategy recommendations.
Proficiency in SQL and at least one BI/analytics tool (Databricks, Data Studio, Tableau, or equivalent); able to independently extract and model data without relying on data teams for every pull.
Experience with web analytics platforms (GA4, Adobe Analytics) and behavioral analytics tools (Amplitude or equivalent).
Solid understanding of digital marketing channels and their specific measurement challenges including paid social, SEM, programmatic, affiliate, and CRM.
Experience with A/B testing and statistical analysis applied to marketing measurement.
Clear, concise communicator: able to translate complex analytical findings into strategic recommendations for non-technical stakeholders and senior leadership.
Detail-oriented and proactive, with a high standard for data accuracy and a bias toward action
Experience with statistical modeling, machine learning applied to marketing (e.g., MMM, propensity models), and mentorship of junior analysts.

Head of Customer and Solutions Marketing at BairesDev

About Etéreo, Auberge Collection

Etéreo, Auberge Collection is located on Mexico’s Riviera Maya, within the luxury Kanai development just 30 miles from Cancun International Airport. Set within a protected mangrove forest along a pristine stretch of the Caribbean Sea, the resort offers 75 luxury accommodations—ranging from 875 sq. ft. Studios to 3,925 sq. ft. three-bedroom Penthouse Suites. Each oceanview retreat features expansive private terraces with floor-to-ceiling glass doors, spa-style bathrooms with dual vanities and soaking tubs, and thoughtful design that blurs the line between indoors and out. From outdoor adventures that immerse guests in the region’s natural wonders to hands-on experiences with local artisans, the resort’s on- and off-site programming is designed to celebrate the vibrancy of the Yucatán and its rich cultural heritage. The resort’s signature dining venue, Itzam, showcases elevated modern Mexican cuisine with a focus on local ingredients, complemented by panoramic ocean views from its open-air seating, lounge terrace, and private dining room, Pixán. At Félix, we are building the indispensable financial companion for Latinos in the US. We combine an AI-powered, conversational-first interface with real-time financial infrastructure to make cross-border money movement as easy as sending a text. Starting with fast, affordable remittances powered by AI and crypto rails, we are expanding into credit, savings, and wallet services to support the complete immigrant financial journey. Our ambition is to deliver a white-glove financial experience with the simplicity of a conversation to a community the traditional financial system has historically overlooked.




We are a hyper-growth Series C company, backed by over $300 million in funding from top-tier global investors, including Andreessen Horowitz, QED, Castle Island, Switch Ventures, HTwenty, Monashees, General Catalyst Customer Value Fund. This isn't just about the numbers; it's a testament to the trust our investors have in our vision and our team. Additionally, Félix was selected as an “Endeavour Entrepreneur” and was a recipient of the CrossTech Fintech Startups Award.




Joining Félix means you will be part of a team building a legacy, a company that will outlive us all. This is a rare opportunity to apply your skills to a deeply meaningful mission—serving a community that has been underserved for too long because we are obsessed with our customers. description:
About Us

SharkNinja is a global product design and technology company, with a diversified portfolio of 5-star rated lifestyle solutions that positively impact people’s lives in homes around the world. Powered by two trusted, global brands, Shark and Ninja, the company has a proven track record of bringing disruptive innovation to market and developing one consumer product after another has allowed SharkNinja to enter multiple product categories, driving significant growth and market share gains. Headquartered in Needham, Massachusetts with more than 4,100 associates, the company’s products are sold at key retailers, online and offline, and through distributors around the world.

AI at SharkNinja 

At SharkNinja, we’re building an AI-native culture. We’re not waiting for the future; we’re creating it. Our people are expected to experiment boldly, adopt new tools, and continuously raise what’s possible to create meaningful impact for our consumers. If you believe the best way to do your job hasn’t been invented yet, you’ll fit right in.

Position Overview

The next big idea can start with a conversation. What are consumers talking about? What’s gaining momentum? What signals are hiding beneath the surface?

We're seeking a Manager, Social Analytics to lead social analytics for Mexico, Brazil, and the growing LATAM market, reporting into the Sr. Director, Social Analytics. This role blends deep social media fluency with 2026-caliber analytics and a genuine curiosity for AI-powered workflows, pairing solid data fundamentals with a growing use of AI agents to surface what matters faster.

At SharkNinja, our Social Analytics teams go deeper to understand the conversations, culture, and consumer behaviors shaping what comes next. In this role, you'll translate fast-moving social signals into actionable insights that can inform regional growth and help identify the next viral SharkNinja product.

You'll manage a stakeholder group spanning regional and global partners, serving as a trusted analytics partner across social, marketing, creative, agencies, and senior leadership. The ideal candidate is equally comfortable working directly with data and communicating what it means — bringing analytical rigor, speed, curiosity, and clarity to a fast-moving environment.

Key Responsibilities


Social Media Analytics: Lead reporting and insights across all social media activity (organic, earned, influencer, and paid) for Mexico, Brazil, and the growing LATAM market; quantify what drives virality and raise the odds of it happening.
Regional Market Focus: Serve as the primary analytics partner for the region, bringing analytical rigor and scalable social measurement. Partner closely with regional social, marketing, and agency leaders.
AI-Driven Insight Generation: Direct the use of AI agents against social and marketing data to surface signal faster — orchestrating intelligent tools against good data, not manual reporting.
Make Data Actionable: Provide fast, actionable analysis to inform regional growth and the next viral SharkNinja product.
Stakeholder Management: Serve as the go-to analytics partner across a broad and growing set of stakeholders — regional social and marketing leaders, creative, agencies, and senior leadership — managing competing priorities with clarity and poise.
KPI Development: Cut through the noise of vanity metrics and define clear, outcome-oriented KPIs — metrics that ladder up to what we're actually here to do: sell products, yes, but more specifically, delight the consumers who use them.
Executive Reporting: Deliver tailored, action-oriented reporting for regional and global stakeholders, automating recurring outputs where possible.
Best Practices & Benchmarks: Conduct rapid analyses to establish benchmarks and evolve measurement approaches for the region.


Attributes & Skills


Bachelor's degree in Analytics, Data Science, Statistics, Economics, Marketing, or a related field required; Master's degree a plus.
6+ years of experience in marketing analytics or social media analytics.
Experience with SQL and modern data platforms such as Snowflake; comfort with AI-assisted analytics tools and agentic workflows a plus.
Solid analytical and spreadsheet fundamentals paired with genuine curiosity about AI-powered and agentic workflows — someone who can work the data directly and is eager to use AI to get to insight faster.
Strong track record analyzing social platforms (Meta, TikTok, YouTube, etc.) and translating insights into clear business and creative actions.
Self-motivated and comfortable managing ambiguity and multiple priorities in a dynamic, fast-paced environment.
Fluency in Spanish and English is required.


Work Environment

This is a primarily on-site role based in Mexico City, Mexico, with flexibility to work from home 1–2 days per week.

"This role blends deep social media fluency with 2026-caliber analytics and a genuine curiosity for AI-powered workflows, pairing solid data fundamentals with a growing use of AI agents to surface what matters faster. You'll manage a stakeholder group spanning regional and global partners, translating fast-moving social signal into action for all of them."

Our Culture

At SharkNinja, we don’t just raise the bar—we push past it every single day. Our Outrageously Extraordinary mindset drives us to tackle the impossible, push boundaries, and deliver results that others only dream of. If you thrive on breaking out of your swim lane, you’ll be right at home.

What We Offer

We offer competitive health insurance, retirement plans, paid time off, employee stock purchase options, wellness programs, SharkNinja product discounts, and more. We empower your personal and professional growth with high impact Learning Programs featuring bold voices redefining what’s possible. When you join, you’re not just part of a company—you’re part of an outrageously extraordinary community. Together, we won’t just launch products—we’ll disrupt entire markets.

At SharkNinja, Diversity, Equity, and Inclusion are vital to our global success. Valuing each unique voice and blending all of our diverse skills strengthens SharkNinja’s innovation every day. We support ALL associates in bringing their authentic selves to work, making an impact, and having the opportunity for career acceleration. With help from our leadership, associates, and our community, we aim to have equity be a key component of the SharkNinja DNA.

 Life At SharkNinja

description:
Acerca de Contalink

En Contalink estamos revolucionando la forma de hacer contabilidad en México. Nuestra plataforma en la nube ayuda a contadores a automatizar sus procesos, ahorrar un 80% de tiempo, atender más clientes con menos esfuerzo y brindar información financiera valiosa para que las empresas tomen mejores decisiones.

Sin embargo nuestro visión va mucho más allá buscando es ser el backbone financiero ayudando a las PYMES a tener información inmediata y libertad del trabajo tedioso con automatización, para que se enfoquen así en ser más rentables , crecer y dedicar más tiempo su familia y sus pasiones

Somos una startup en rápido crecimiento, respaldada por un grupo de inversionistas de todo el mundo entre los que destacan YCombinator, Scribble , FoundersX, Liquid2Ventures y 500 Startups entre muchos otros.

Este año sobrepasamos los 10M USD de ARR en ventas y seguimos creciendo muy fuerte para llegar a nuestro objetivo de alcanzar 100M USD de ARR al 2030. Actualmente atendemos a aproximadamente 25.000 clientes, quienes a su vez administran a más de 400.000 contribuyentes en nuestra plataforma. Somos una de las empresas de Software propietario más grande del país.




Acerca del rol

En Contalink buscamos a una persona con experiencia en creación de contenido especializado, conocimiento del sector contable y una gran capacidad para conectar con audiencias profesionales.

Tu misión será convertir a Contalink en una fuente de información de referencia para los contadores en México, creando contenido relevante, útil y confiable que ayude a los profesionales a mantenerse actualizados, resolver problemas y mejorar la manera en que trabajan.

No buscamos crear publicaciones únicamente para hablar de nuestro producto. Queremos construir una comunidad que encuentre tanto valor en nuestro contenido que regrese, participe y lo recomiende.




¿Qué harás en tu día a día?

Serás responsable de investigar, desarrollar y distribuir contenido que posicione a Contalink como una marca de referencia dentro de la comunidad contable.

Para lograrlo, trabajarás en cuatro áreas principales:

1. Investigación y estrategia editorial

Identificar tendencias, reformas fiscales, noticias y temas relevantes para contadores.
Investigar las necesidades, dudas y desafíos de los profesionales contables.
Diseñar una agenda editorial que combine temas de actualidad con contenido de valor a largo plazo.
Entrevistar a contadores y especialistas para desarrollar contenido con perspectivas y ejemplos reales.
Verificar fuentes y datos para asegurar la precisión de la información publicada.

2. Creación de contenido especializado

Redactar artículos, guías prácticas, newsletters y publicaciones para redes sociales.
Transformar temas contables, fiscales y financieros complejos en contenido claro, atractivo y fácil de comprender.
Desarrollar guiones y crear contenido narrado en formatos de audio y video.
Crear piezas gráficas sencillas y colaborar con Diseño cuando el contenido lo requiera.
Adaptar una misma investigación a distintos formatos y plataformas.

3. Crecimiento y desarrollo de audiencia

Gestionar el calendario editorial de LinkedIn, blog, newsletters y otros canales.
Identificar oportunidades para colaborar con expertos, profesionales y comunidades contables.
Desarrollar contenido que incentive conversaciones, participación y recomendaciones.
Convertir las preguntas e intereses de la audiencia en nuevas oportunidades de contenido.
Implementar iniciativas que impulsen el crecimiento de suscriptores y lectores recurrentes.

4. Análisis y optimización

Medir el desempeño del contenido e identificar qué temas y formatos generan mayor interés.
Analizar métricas de alcance, engagement, suscripciones y retención de audiencia.
Experimentar con nuevos enfoques, formatos y estrategias de distribución.
Utilizar los resultados para mejorar continuamente la estrategia editorial.




¿Qué buscamos?

Experiencia creando contenido especializado para audiencias profesionales. Como referencia, buscamos al menos 3 años de experiencia relevante.
Conocimiento sólido en temas contables y fiscales, así como comprensión de los desafíos de los contadores en México.
Excelente redacción, ortografía y habilidad para explicar información técnica de manera sencilla.
Experiencia creando artículos, publicaciones, guiones y contenido para distintos canales.
Capacidad para investigar, contrastar fuentes y desarrollar contenido confiable.
Experiencia utilizando métricas para mejorar el rendimiento del contenido.
Manejo de herramientas de diseño y edición que permitan producir contenido de manera autónoma.
Portafolio que demuestre la calidad de tu trabajo y experiencia desarrollando audiencias.




Será un plus si:

Formación académica o experiencia profesional en Contaduría.
Experiencia en periodismo especializado, medios financieros o comunidades profesionales.
Conocimientos de SEO, email marketing y distribución de newsletters.
Experiencia creando contenido en video y desenvolviéndote frente a cámara.
Experiencia utilizando herramientas de inteligencia artificial para investigación y creación de contenido, siempre con criterio y verificación.




Modalidad de trabajo

🌎 100% remoto, bajo una cultura digital-first.

Tenemos reuniones presenciales en nuestra oficina de Monterrey, Nuevo León, aproximadamente una semana por trimestre. Los gastos relacionados con traslado y hospedaje son cubiertos por Contalink.




Beneficios de trabajar en Contalink

Compensación competitiva acorde a tu experiencia y nivel de seniority.
$2,000 MXN mensuales adicionales en vales de despensa y apoyo para trabajo desde casa.
Vacaciones disponibles desde tu ingreso y día libre para celebrar tu cumpleaños.
Seguro de gastos médicos mayores, acompañamiento psicológico a través de Terapify y acceso a gimnasios a través de TotalPass.
Libros y recursos de aprendizaje para apoyar tu desarrollo profesional, cubiertos por Contalink.




¿Por qué unirte a Contalink?

Tendrás la oportunidad de construir una estrategia de contenido con impacto real, dentro de una empresa tecnológica en crecimiento.

Buscamos a alguien que no solo ejecute ideas, sino que proponga, experimente y tome decisiones para desarrollar una comunidad profesional cada vez más grande.

Tu trabajo ayudará a miles de contadores a mantenerse informados, mejorar sus prácticas profesionales y descubrir nuevas maneras de trabajar.




¡Nos encantará conocerte! 🚀

Postúlate y construyamos juntos una de las comunidades de contenido contable más relevantes de México.

AUBE Group México is a multidisciplinary ecosystem focused on community wellbeing and the development of sustainable, lifestyle-driven projects. The group integrates design, real estate, events, sports, culture, tourism, and hospitality to promote the wellbeing of people and the planet. Its regenerative real estate developments, architecture, and sustainable construction systems are complemented by transformative experiences and community gatherings. AUBE fosters active indoor and outdoor lifestyles while honoring local culture and surroundings. Team members join a collaborative environment dedicated to shaping meaningful, sustainable ways of living.




Role Description:

The Marketing Specialist is a full-time, on-site role based in Morelia, Michoacán. Advanced Excel proficiency, including nested formulas, pivot tables, Power Query, and data modeling.

Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, with the ability to interpret complex datasets and translate findings into actionable recommendations.

description:
About the Team

The Consumer Performance Marketing team owns the execution of paid social acquisition across Meta, TikTok, and Snapchat. We operate at scale across the U.S. and Canada, managing complex builds, pacing routines, live optimizations, QA workflows, and experiment cycles that directly impact consumer growth.

We work closely with U.S.-based Channel Managers, Creative, Analytics, and Martech, functioning as one integrated performance engine. This requires strong operational discipline, fast signal interpretation, and a mindset focused on translating platform behavior into clear, actionable steps.

While the team is execution-heavy, we also influence strategy by shaping testing agendas, surfacing insights, and partnering with platform reps on betas and new product rollouts. It's a high-ownership environment for operators who thrive in fast, data-driven systems.

About the Role

This role owns the tactical execution of Consumer paid social campaigns end-to-end. You will build, QA, pace, optimize, and iterate campaigns across Meta, TikTok, and Snap, managing multi-million-dollar budgets with precision.

You'll partner with U.S. teams and platform reps to run experiments, test new bidding approaches, evaluate audience structures, and support creative testing. You will also be expected to diagnose issues quickly, communicate insights clearly, and maintain structurally sound accounts.

This position requires someone who can execute with technical depth, think analytically, and move fast — ensuring each optimization ties directly to performance outcomes.

About Teleflex Incorporated

As a global provider of medical technologies, Teleflex is driven by our purpose to improve the health and quality of people’s lives. Through our vision to become the most trusted partner in healthcare, we offer a diverse portfolio with solutions in the therapy areas of anesthesia, emergency medicine, interventional cardiology and radiology, surgical, vascular access, and urology. We believe that the potential of great people, purpose-driven innovation, and world-class products can shape the future direction of healthcare.

Teleflex is the home of Arrow™, Barrigel™, Deknatel™, LMA™, Pilling™, QuikClot™, Rüsch™, UroLift™ and Weck™ – trusted brands united by a common sense of purpose.

At Teleflex, we are empowering the future of healthcare. For more information, please visit teleflex.com.

Latin America - The Latin America Region of Teleflex is headquartered in Morrisville, North Carolina, and supports our customers, distributors, sales managers and specialists in Mexico, Brazil, Colombia, Chile, Argentina and Puerto Rico. The Latin America Region sells a broad spectrum of medical devices and related products in the fields of vascular and interventional access, surgical, anesthesia, cardiac care, urology, emergency medicine and respiratory care. As Teleflex grows and expands its portfolio, we will continue to grow our presence in Latin America. Join a dynamic, growing team that offers healthcare providers an array of medical technology solutions that make a difference in patients’ lives.

We offer unique advertising products, enterprise ad tech, and premium brand placements on our owned and operated streaming properties, including Prime Video, Live Sports, Twitch and FireTV, as well as on third-party publishers via Amazon Publisher Services and our Open Internet video offering.

We strive to make advertising relevant so that customers welcome it and advertisers can easily implement it. If you're interested in innovative advertising solutions with a relentless focus on the customer, you've come to the right place!

The Video GTM and Specialist team sits squarely between the product teams who make our ad solutions, and the sales teams who sell it. Partnering across WW and Regional Product, GTM, Specialist, Sales and Publisher teams to help architect video advertising growth.

We are seeking a Mexico Video GTM to join our organization focused on driving the unified go-to-market strategy for advertising solutions across Amazon's Video properties in Mexico with specific coverage across Prime Video Ads, Live Sports and Streaming TV. The ideal candidate will have deep video expertise including streaming TV (STV) and ad tech, bringing innovative products and solutions to market, and partnering across teams to lead the industry in driving video solutions for customers. You'll bridge the crucial gap between market needs and product development, ensuring our advertising customers understand how our video solutions meet business objectives across Mexico.

This is an exciting opportunity to be part of a fast-growing and entrepreneurial organisation, bringing passion for video-centric advertising and innovative thinking to grow adoption of Amazon Video Ads and scale revenue across one of the world's most dynamic advertising regions.

Do you want to shape how Amazon partners with the technology ecosystem to deliver value at scale? As a Technical Business Developer III, you will identify, evaluate, negotiate, and manage complex partnerships that drive meaningful business outcomes across organizations. You will define and execute business development strategy that complements product direction, turning market insights and partner and customer feedback into actionable plans that influence product roadmaps and go-to-market approaches. This role puts you at the center of high-impact deal-making, cross-functional collaboration, and strategic planning.

Key job responsibilities


 Own the end-to-end GTM strategy for Amazon’s video advertising offerings in Mexico across Prime Video Ads, Live Sports, and Open Internet Video/STV
 Develop the vision for positioning, pricing, packaging and planning of Amazon’s video advertising solutions, in alignment with WW and local teams
 Maintain a firm grasp of the Mexico video advertising marketplace and competitive landscape to identify, assess and act on emerging opportunities
 Conduct quantitative analysis of demand, including opportunity sizing across traditional demand channels and emerging demand sources specific to Mexico
 Analyse and recommend trade-offs between price, volume and yield-generating strategies
 Identify and provide the right metrics to measure success, providing meaningful feedback to stakeholders through ownership of monthly organizational business reviews
 Effectively communicate the business strategy to all levels of the organization, up to and including SVPs
 Work directly with Mexico Video Sales Specialists (VSS), Large Customer Sales (LCS), Global Growth Sales (GGS) and local sales teams on enablement and demand generation strategies to achieve revenue and adoption targets
 Partner cross-functionally to develop compelling narratives around our video and ad tech advertising solutions and drive sales enablement and demand generation strategies
 Aggregate Mexico Voice of Customer (VOC) and partner with WW GTM to drive video solutions for customers and revenue growth across Amazon’s video properties
 Drive growth of Prime Video Ads, Live Sports and Open Internet Video offerings, including business management in support of Video org goals around revenue, product adoption and advertiser maturity advancement
 Produce stack-ranked Mexico sales priorities to influence product requirements, roadmap decisions and trade-offs
 Partner cross-functionally to develop and deliver sales enablement content, tools and training tailored to the Brazil marketplace and sales team needs


A day in the life


 Works alongside the Video Sales Specialist team to connect global GTM and Product teams to local sales teams and advertising customers
 Connects with WW Product and GTM teams to translate global roadmap updates into Mexico-specific go-to-market actions
 Reviews pipeline and demand signals with VSS and local sales teams
 Develops and iterates on positioning narratives, pitch decks, and enablement assets
 Analyses market data and competitive intelligence to inform pricing and packaging decisions
 Leads or participates in monthly business reviews, presenting performance metrics and strategic recommendations


About The Team

Our team sits at the heart of Amazon Ads’ international expansion, driving the video advertising growth story across new and emerging marketplaces. We start with the customer and work backwards in everything we do. We believe that advertising, when done well, enhances the customer experience — building unique connections between brands and consumers, from discovery to loyalty, in a way unlike any other media platform at scale. The Video GTM and Specialist team operates with the pace and ambition of a start-up, backed by the scale and infrastructure of Amazon.

Basic Qualifications


 5+ years of professional or military experience
 Knowledge of publisher ad tech stacks and/or advertising technology
 6+ years of Go-To-Market, Business Development, Sales, or Consulting experience
 Knowledge of the AdTech industry (e.g., Ad Servers, SSPs, DSPs)
 Experience working with and influencing senior level stakeholders
 Experience at a media, entertainment or advertising technology company
 Deep knowledge of the Mexican digital media and advertising landscape, including agency structures, buying behaviours and market dynamics
 Strong analytical and quantitative skills with the ability to use data and metrics to build business cases, develop opportunity models and conduct root cause analyses
 Excellent communication skills (written and verbal) in English and Spanish
 Experience building and deploying GTM strategies with emphasis on packaging, positioning and messaging


Preferred Qualifications


 Experience interpreting data and making business recommendations
 Experience explaining complex technical concepts to various business and technical audiences
 Experience representing and advocating for a variety of critical customers and working cross-functionally
 Extensive knowledge of digital media, video advertising and Ad Tech (e.g. DSPs, programmatic media, premium digital video, performance advertising, identity resolution)

It’s our people who bring this mission to life. At Emma, you’ll join a driven, international team that values ownership, collaboration, and continuous knowledge sharing. You will research markets, identify emerging trends and commercial opportunities, and translate complex business issues into compelling event propositions for senior executives. You will also build relationships with key industry decision-makers, curate high-value content, and recruit senior-level speakers.

This is a conference product creation role rather than an event logistics position. Your focus will be on market intelligence, commercial strategy, content development, and creating must-attend events that help shape important industry conversations.

Key Responsibilities

Research Markets: Conduct in-depth research to understand emerging trends, business challenges, customer priorities, and growth opportunities across critical industries.

Shape Industry Conversations: Create conferences that address important opportunities and challenges and contribute to how industries respond to them.

A university degree in any discipline.

Experience researching industries, markets, customers, or emerging business trends.
Experience developing conference agendas, business content, event propositions, or other market-led products.
Experience engaging with senior executives, industry leaders, or prospective speakers.

Demonstrated interest in global business trends and the issues influencing senior-level decision-makers.


What’s in it For You?


Hybrid Work Model: We’ve adopted a flexible hybrid working environment for our office-based roles while delivering a seamless experience that is digitally and physically connected.
Flexibility & Work-Life Balance: Flex My Way is a set of supportive workplace policies designed to help manage personal and professional responsibilities, whether caring for family, giving back to the community, or finding time to refresh and reset. This builds upon our flexible work arrangements, including work from anywhere for up to 8 weeks per year, empowering employees to achieve a better work-life balance.
Career Development and Growth: By fostering a culture of continuous learning and skill development, we prepare our talent to tackle tomorrow’s challenges and deliver real-world solutions. Our Grow My Way programming and skills-first approach ensures you have the tools and knowledge to grow, lead, and thrive in an AI-enabled future.
Industry Competitive Benefits: We offer comprehensive benefit plans to include flexible vacation, two company-wide Mental Health Days off, access to the Headspace app, retirement savings, tuition reimbursement, employee incentive programs, and resources for mental, physical, and financial wellbeing.

Social Impact: Make an impact in your community with our Social Impact Institute. We offer employees two paid volunteer days off annually and opportunities to get involved with pro-bono consulting projects and Environmental, Social, and Governance (ESG) initiatives.
Making a Real-World Impact: We are one of the few companies globally that helps its customers pursue justice, truth, and transparency. Together, with the professionals and institutions we serve, we help uphold the rule of law, turn the wheels of commerce, catch bad actors, report the facts, and provide trusted, unbiased information to people all over the world.


About Us

Thomson Reuters informs the way forward by bringing together the trusted content and technology that people and organizations need to make the right decisions. We serve professionals across legal, tax, accounting, compliance, government, and media. Our products combine highly specialized software and insights to empower professionals with the data, intelligence, and solutions needed to make informed decisions, and to help institutions in their pursuit of justice, truth, and transparency. Nu serves more than 140 million customers, guided by a mission to fight complexity and empower people. The company has been leading an industry transformation through innovative products and human-centered services.

Proprietary technology and data at scale power Nu’s digital platform, built to promote financial access, advancement, and transparency. Its business model thrives on customer love and lower costs, feeding a flywheel of growth and profitability.

Visit our Institutional Page

About The Role

REGEX (Registration Experience) owns the longest and most conversion-intensive stage of Nubank Mexico’s onboarding funnel: the ~30-screen Registration flow covering identity verification, CURP, biometrics, address, consents and contracts. This is the stage that turns a qualified prospect into a Nu customer, so every improvement moves our Onboarding Rate and customer releases.

As a Senior Product Manager in Nubank Mexico’s Growth organization, you will co-own the strategy, roadmap and results of this flow, with Onboarding Rate and Registration conversion as your core metrics. Co-owning the vision, strategy and roadmap of the Registration flow, with Onboarding Rate and Registration conversion as your core metrics.

description:
We’re looking for experienced marketing leaders in roles such as Head of Marketing, VP of Marketing, Marketing Director, Growth Marketing Leader, or CMO who have built B2B marketing functions, led marketing teams, and owned end-to-end marketing strategy and execution, with a strong focus on search (SEO and AEO/GEO) and demand generation.




Remote (LATAM) · Reports to our Co-CEO




About Viva Talent

Viva Talent connects US companies with Executive Assistants and Recruiting Coordinators and opens meaningful, career-defining work for talented people across Latin America and South Africa. We're a globally distributed team of 240+ people across 16+ countries and 3 continents, on a mission to expand real opportunity for women in LatAm.




Why this role exists

Viva’s gearing up for its next growth phase. We need you to build our marketing function from the ground up and improve/accelerate the sustainable pipeline of qualified buyers that drives more revenue.

This is a build-and-lead seat: you’ll set the strategy, get it moving yourself, then hire and coach the team that runs it. If getting into the weeds makes you excited, this is your seat. If being a player-coach does not excite you, or being the player until you hire the team to coach, this is not the role for you.




What you’ll do

Two numbers you'll be measured on: Inbound calls booked and Inbound closed-won deals.

Define and lead marketing strategy. Decide where we place our next bets and where we don’t: focus, channel mix, budget allocation, quarterly rocks. ← This is the 1st problem you'll own.
Execute the strategy. Once you build the plan and identify the processes, tools, and support needed, make it happen and use results to decide what to improve next. ← This is the 2nd problem you’ll own.
Build the team. Hire, develop, and coach the team you need to deliver results (e.g., SEO, content, design, link building, etc), and vendors where/if it makes sense.
Connect marketing to business outcomes. Plan OKRs with leadership, define success metrics, and track progress so everyone has a clear view of what it will take to see results.
Own our narrative. Shape Viva’s story, messaging, and positioning so the right buyers understand why Viva, why our services, and why now.
Drive cross-functional alignment. Work with both Co-CEOs and leaders across Sales, Customer Success, People, and RevOps to keep priorities aligned, keep HubSpot lead reporting accurate, and diagnose funnel issues together.




Who you are

You’re a hands-on marketing leader who has already solved this challenge elsewhere.

5+ years managing & leading marketing teams end to end, from defining the strategy to driving execution and results.
You’ve owned SEO end to end and scaled it from 1 to N, and have worked with AEO/GEO. You’ve also built other channels such as events or paid ads from 0 to 1.
You’ve hired, coached, and developed marketing teams, and managed external vendors and agencies.
You’ve generated qualified pipeline for B2B companies with $50k+ ACV.
You’ve marketed to US executive buyers, ideally C-suite, VP, or Head-level, at tech companies from scale-ups to enterprise.
Executive-level English (C1+). You keep up in fast-paced conversations with executives, clearly explain your decisions and the reasoning behind them, and negotiate trade-offs and how plans move forward.




Why you’ll want this

This is a rare seat where you build the function instead of inheriting it. You'll own the number, the playbook, and the team, with a direct line to the founders and real autonomy over how Viva grows.

The work you’ll do will be pivotal to Viva’s growth, revenue, and team and will directly impact how we reach our mission of creating 1,000 meaningful career opportunities across Latin America.




Benefits

We invest heavily in our people through:

100% remote work, forever.
Competitive compensation with reviews every six months and performance bonuses.
Comprehensive global health insurance, including medical, dental, vision, mental health, and routine care.
Paid holidays, vacation, sick leave, and family care days.
Family-friendly policies, including parental leave and flexible support.
A culture centered around growth, ownership, well-being, and continuous learning.

With a 4.7/5 Glassdoor rating, we're proud of the experience we create for both our candidates and our team.




How we hire

A focused process: application → initial interview → a practical skills assessment → assessment debrief → final interview




All Viva communication will come from an @execviva.com email. If you receive messages from unofficial sources (for example, Instagram or Facebook), please report them to careers@execviva.com. We never request payments or personal information from candidates.

Company Description

Louis Dreyfus Company es una empresa líder en la comercialización y transformación de productos agrícolas. Estructurada como una organización matricial de seis regiones geográficas y diez plataformas, Louis Dreyfus Company opera en más de 100 países y emplea aproximadamente a 18.000 personas en todo el mundo.

Structure and coordinate the regional research function - working closely with our trading/research personnel throughout the region and Geneva.

title: KAM e-Commerce
description:
The Key Account Manager, eCommerce is responsible for building and accelerating the profitable growth of the assigned category in Mexico’s digital ecosystem, with a focus on Amazon Mexico and/or Mercado Libre.




The role combines commercial ownership of the account with deep expertise in marketplaces, digital shelf, analytics and ecommerce operations. It turns shopper, traffic, conversion, availability, content and pricing data into commercial decisions that drive profitable growth and market share.

More than operating platforms, the role must understand what drives growth on each marketplace, anticipate opportunities and build strategic partnerships with Amazon and/or Mercado Libre. Success requires cross-functional influence across Marketing, Digital Marketing, Customer Marketing, Demand Planning, Supply Chain, Customer Service, Finance and Logistics.




KEY RESPONSIBILITIES

30% – Commercial Strategy and Channel Planning

• Design and execute the annual category plan by platform, with targets for sales, growth, margin, share, digital distribution and profitability.

• Build the Joint Business Plans (JBP) and growth plans with Amazon Mexico and Mercado Libre, identifying growth drivers, opportunities, risks and joint commitments.

• Define the role of each SKU on each platform, including innovation, bundles and exclusives.

• Identify new digital growth opportunities through assortment expansion, 1P/3P models, special programs and new digital ecosystems.

• Lead the launch and innovation strategy for ecommerce, ensuring availability, content and promotional plans from day one.

• Build the annual commercial calendar by platform, including Prime Day, Hot Sale, Buen Fin, Black Friday and other key events.

• Monitor market, competitor and shopper trends to identify white spaces and share opportunities.

• Evolve the relationship with Vendor Managers, Category Managers and the commercial teams at Amazon and/or Mercado Libre from transactional to strategic growth partnership.

Key KPIs: Net Sales/Sell-out · Growth · Market/Category Share · Incremental Sales · Gross Margin/Contribution · Innovation Sales · JBP Delivery.




20% – P&L, Forecast and Supply

• Manage the category P&L by platform and key SKUs, understanding the real economics of the business from Invoice Sales to Gross Margin.

• Define the pricing, assortment and channel strategy to balance growth and profitability while protecting brand equity and price consistency across channels.

• Lead forecast and demand planning with Supply Chain by platform and SKU, anticipating needs for events, launches and peak periods.

• Monitor forecast accuracy, availability, OOS, Confirmation Rate, Fill Rate, inventory health and sell-through.

• Ensure enough inventory to capture demand without excess or aged stock, using the applicable fulfillment models (Vendor Flex, FBA, Mercado Libre Full).

• Manage commercial investments within approved guidelines and budget, ensuring ROI and documentation.

• Work with Finance on chargebacks, shortage claims and reconciliations, keeping commercial accountability.

• Develop scenarios and recommendations that balance growth, availability, investment, pricing and profitability.

Key KPIs: Net Sales · Gross Margin/Contribution · Forecast Accuracy · Availability/OOS · Confirmation Rate · Fill Rate · Inventory Health · Chargebacks.

30% – Digital Shelf and Platform Management

• Manage the digital shelf as the online equivalent of the Perfect Store, ensuring priority SKUs meet standards for availability, findability, content, competitiveness and conversion.

• Ensure catalog health and quality on Amazon and/or Mercado Libre: listings, ASINs, variants, categorization, attributes and incident resolution.

• Lead continuous optimization of digital content: titles, images, videos, A+ Content, Brand Stores and platform-specific assets.

• Improve searchability and discoverability through keyword research, content quality and marketplace best practices.

• Monitor organic ranking, traffic, CTR, CVR, ratings, reviews and availability, identifying root causes of performance gaps and defining corrective actions.

• Drive operational excellence in Amazon Vendor Central, Seller Central and Mercado Libre: orders, promotions, availability, incidents and account health.

• Work with Customer Marketing and Marketing to produce and update digital assets that keep the brand consistent.

• Use ratings, reviews and shopper questions as insight into product, content and experience opportunities.

Key KPIs: Availability/OOS · Organic Ranking · PDP Traffic · CTR · CVR · Content Quality/Completeness · Ratings & Reviews · Catalog Health.

20% – Analytics and Insights

• Analyze the digital funnel (Traffic → PDP → CVR → Sales) to find whether a performance gap comes from traffic, content, availability, competitiveness or conversion.

• Use Amazon Brand Analytics, Mercado Libre tools and other sources to understand search behavior, competition and share.

• Integrate sales, traffic, content, inventory and profitability data to generate actionable insights, not just reports.

• Build dashboards and business reviews that explain what is happening, why, what the opportunity is and what action to take.

• Use AI and automation to speed up analysis, detect anomalies, research keywords and trends, optimize content and automate reporting.

Key KPIs: Traffic · CTR · CVR · Share of Search · Sales by channel/SKU · Insights turned into actions.




BUSINESS IMPACT

Level of autonomy

High in daily platform operations — the KAM makes independent decisions on listing optimization, catalog, content and incident response. Escalates to the Business Manager decisions on pricing outside approved guidelines, commercial investment above the authorized range and major account incidents.

Key relationships

• Internal: Amazon and/or Mercado Libre Business Manager, Marketing, Digital Marketing, Customer Marketing, Demand Planning, Supply Chain, Customer Service, Finance, Credit and Logistics.

• External: Vendor Managers and Category Managers at Amazon Mexico, Key Account Managers at Mercado Libre Mexico and digital content agencies.

Problem-solving complexity

Very high. Ecommerce operates in real time — an algorithm change, a listing suppression or a pricing issue can affect sales within hours, not days. The KAM must diagnose platform, commercial and content problems at the same time, with high tolerance for ambiguity and the ability to decide quickly with incomplete information. Pricing decisions on marketplaces can also cascade across other channels.

Interpersonal skills

The role requires fluent executive communication in English and Spanish (platform interfaces and Amazon contacts often operate in English). Ability to explain platform concepts to non-specialist stakeholders (Finance, Supply Chain, management) and to operate with autonomy in a constantly changing environment.

The successful candidate will help turn the category into a scalable, data-driven and highly collaborative growth engine on Mexico’s leading marketplaces.




MINIMUM REQUIREMENTS

Education

• Bachelor’s degree in Marketing, Business Administration, Digital Communication, Industrial Engineering, International Trade or a related field.

• Specialization, diploma or certification in ecommerce, digital marketing or marketplace management — desirable. MBA — valuable.

Experience

• Minimum 5 years of experience managing accounts on Amazon Mexico (Vendor Central and/or Seller Central) and Mercado Libre, with direct responsibility for sales and content.

• Proven experience in listing optimization and fulfillment management (FBA or Mercado Libre Full) — required.

• Background in consumer goods, durable goods or retail — preferred.

• Experience building ecommerce channel P&Ls with platform fees, logistics costs and commercial investment — desirable.

• Proven ability to influence cross-functional teams and senior stakeholders.

Competencies

• Analytical, data-driven mindset — decisions based on platform metrics, not intuition.

• Results orientation and self-management — able to manage multiple platforms and projects without daily supervision.

• Commercial thinking — understands the business beyond the platform: how ecommerce affects other channels and how real profitability differs from gross price.

• Agility and fast learning — marketplace algorithms, policies and tools change constantly.

• Executive communication in English and Spanish.

• Attention to detail — an error in a list price, ASIN category or listing can have immediate commercial impact.

Technical skills — required proficiency

• Amazon Vendor Central: catalog, POs, shortage claims, chargebacks, reports and A+ Content.

• Amazon Seller Central (desirable): listings, FBA shipments, account health and Brand Registry.

• Amazon Brand Analytics: Search Query Performance, Search Funnel Analytics and Market Basket Analysis.

• Mercado Libre Seller Center: listings, variants, catalog, reputation, questions and Mercado Libre Full logistics.

• Advanced Excel: pivot tables, channel P&L models and net pricing simulators.

• Power BI / Tableau / Looker Studio or equivalent: dashboards, data integration and reporting automation.

• Marketplace keyword research tools (Helium 10, Jungle Scout, DataDive or equivalent) — desirable.

• Regular use of artificial intelligence to analyze large volumes of data, detect anomalies, research keywords and trends, optimize content and automate reporting.

• Advanced English — minimum B2+, verifiable.




Other requirements

• Availability to respond to critical platform incidents outside business hours when operations require it.

• Willingness to keep up continuously with changes in marketplace policies, algorithms and tools.

• Experience or willingness to work with digital content agencies and coordinate asset production to marketplace standards.
